name: python-yaml-test
description: Python development environment with pip and venv (YAML)

scripts.setup:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Upgrade pip
python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

echo "Python environment setup complete"
scripts.postInstall:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Verify installations
python3 --version
pip3 --version

# Create virtual environment directory
mkdir -p /workspace

echo "Python YAML blueprint environment ready!"
